item.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
item.description: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

item.description: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
item.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
item.description: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

item.title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
item.description: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

item.title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that

item.title: Veteran reporter asks SCOTUS to hear case on protecting confidential sources
item.description: A longtime national security reporter is facing steep fines in a civil lawsuit for failing to disclose her source. She's asking the Supreme Court to weigh in.

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
item.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

item.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.
item.content:encoded:
